description: Complete premium UI/UX overhaul of site1 - transform the clean minimal profile into an impeccable, modern, visually rich personal brand page. This is a single comprehensive feature that covers all visual, structural, and interactive enhancements.
steps: Upgrade the color system in style.css: introduce CSS custom properties (variables) for a richer palette with primary (#6C8EBF), secondary/accent colors, gradients for backgrounds, and a dark mode toggle using CSS-only checkbox/label hack. Add a subtle gradient or mesh-style background to the body instead of flat #fafafa.

Enhance typography in style.css: add a third font weight tier, improve heading sizes and spacing for stronger visual hierarchy, add decorative elements (subtle underlines, accent marks) to section headings, increase line-height differentiation between body text and display text.

Redesign the Hero section in index.html and style.css: make it full-viewport-height with a dramatic gradient background, add a glassmorphism card for the content area, enhance the avatar with a glowing ring/pulse animation, add a secondary subtitle line, and improve the CTA button with gradient fill and glow effect.

Add a new 'Impact Stats' section in index.html after About Me: a horizontal row of 4 stat cards showing key numbers (e.g., '12+' Years Experience, '35K+' Tool Executions, '518' GitHub Stars, '5' AWS Certifications) with large bold numbers and small labels, styled with subtle borders and hover lift effects.

Add a new 'Testimonials' section in index.html with 2-3 mock testimonial cards: each with a quote, name, and role. Style with quote marks, italic text, subtle background, and card design with avatar placeholder.
Redesign the Skills section: convert flat tags into categorized pill groups or a visual skills grid with subtle progress indicators or icon-style badges. Add hover glow effects.
Upgrade the Experience timeline: add a visible vertical line connecting entries with dot markers, improve card styling for each entry with left-border accent color, and add subtle hover animations.

Enhance the Projects section: improve card design with better shadow layering, add a subtle gradient overlay on hover, improve the featured card with a ribbon/badge element, and add hover state that reveals additional info.
Add a new 'Currently Learning / Interests' section with icon-based cards showing current focus areas (e.g., GenAI, Serverless, Community Building) - mock content encouraged.
Redesign the Fun Facts section: use icon-highlighted cards with a colored left border accent, larger emoji treatment, and improved grid spacing.
Upgrade the Connect/Social section: make social links into branded-color buttons/pills (LinkedIn blue, GitHub dark) with hover animations.

Add sophisticated CSS animations: staggered entrance animations per section, smooth scroll-snap behavior, parallax-style layered backgrounds using CSS transforms, pulse effects on key elements, and a subtle noise/grain texture overlay for depth.

Implement CSS-only dark mode toggle: use a hidden checkbox + label pattern in the header area with a sun/moon icon toggle. Define dark mode color variables and apply them when the checkbox is checked, transitioning all colors smoothly.

Ensure full responsiveness: test and refine all new elements at mobile (< 600px), tablet (600-900px), and desktop (> 900px) breakpoints. Add a tablet breakpoint media query. Ensure dark mode works at all sizes.
Add a subtle top navigation bar (fixed/sticky) with the person's name on the left and the dark mode toggle on the right, using frosted-glass/backdrop-filter effect.
Polish footer: add a subtle gradient separator, improve layout with multiple columns or centered elegant design, add a 'back to top' anchor link.
acceptance_criteria: site1/index.html is valid HTML5 with no JavaScript
site1/style.css uses CSS custom properties for theming
A CSS-only dark mode toggle is present and functional
At least 2 new content sections are added (Stats, Testimonials, or similar)
The hero section is visually dramatic with gradient background and enhanced animations
All sections have improved card designs with hover effects
The timeline has a visible connecting line element
Responsive design works at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths
A sticky/fixed navigation bar is present
The page maintains semantic HTML structure
verification: Run 'cat site1/index.html | grep -c "<script" ' to verify no JavaScript (should output 0)
Run 'grep -c "--" site1/style.css' to verify CSS custom properties are used
Run 'grep -c "prefers-reduced-motion" site1/style.css' to verify accessibility is maintained
Run 'grep -c "dark" site1/style.css' to verify dark mode styles exist
Visually inspect the HTML structure is valid by checking opening/closing tags
